scientific_integrity: Uniform Dirichlet-multinomial mass formula is established background. Newly assessed mathematical statement is the exact covariance sign-root phase and \(q^{-2}\) critical-window law; full proof and reproducible finite checks included. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-size theorem for equal initial one-ball weights, unit reinforcement, distinct singleton-color indicators, \(q\ge3\) and \(n\ge2\). Critical scaling is for \(n=q+\lfloor s\sqrt q\rfloor\); boundary at \(s=\pm1\) requires finite-root analysis. Earlier equivalent historical formulations are possible, particularly in inaccessible full text of Chen (1981).
